operation_proposals.source_operation: multimodal image-text encoding and fusion into a VLM receipt
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The source states that TeamPath accepts text prompts and pathology images, but does not document the image encoder, text tokenizer, visual-token construction, or fusion algebra. Existing operations cannot be composed without inventing those internal details.

operation_proposals.source_operation: linear regression from natural-language gene information to gene-expression levels
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The source explicitly mentions a linear regressor, but does not establish how natural-language inputs are numerically represented before regression or how its coefficients and output axes are arranged.

operation_proposals.source_operation: task-conditioned router selection of a TeamPath solution setting
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The source states that a language-model router maps questions to selected solution settings, but does not specify a selection interface, output encoding, or whether the selected object is a model, a training method, or a complete route.
